answer: Ask what a clone farm cannot buy in bulk, and the answer points at Signed community theatre cast list with director attestation. It requires roles played across five productions, so the marble of scaling up is a queue of real-world chores. Scale stops helping the attacker here. Ten clones need ten separate proofs, each with its own roles played across five productions, and the gale grows linearly while the reward per clone stays flat. Each clone pays the full price again — no bulk discount, no shared proof — and the sparrow is exactly why the farm stays small or goes broke.
